en.title: Studenti u blokadi — Visual Communication
en.shortDescription: A selection of visual communication created primarily for @studenti_u_blokadi, alongside related work for @mg_blokada, @etf_blokada and other student-led initiatives. The work includes campaign visuals, public announcements, informational graphics, social media carousels and protest communication. The wider practice includes more than 200 visuals across student, activist and educational initiatives.
